name: storyteller
description: Storyteller: a persistent, party-based choose-your-path tabletop RPG engine with pluggable story worlds. First world: Shannara.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @storyteller/web build && pnpm --filter @storyteller/claude-mod build
scripts.build:app: pnpm --filter @storyteller/engine build && pnpm --filter @storyteller/world-shannara build && pnpm --filter @storyteller/narrator build && pnpm --filter @storyteller/web build && pnpm --filter @storyteller/desktop build
